2026_02_IND_KC.headline: Indianapolis brings Richardson’s mobility into an Arrowhead protection test
2026_02_IND_KC.paragraph1: Anthony Richardson returned to full practice after a groin issue, giving Indianapolis its designed-run and off-schedule element against Kansas City. The Colts will be without Ashton Dulin, while Kansas City ruled out tackle Josh Simmons and defensive back Chamarri Conner; Chris Jones is questionable. Patrick Mahomes practiced fully despite a knee listing. Indianapolis must contain Kansas City’s extended plays, while the Chiefs’ protection and defensive interior health could shape whether Richardson can keep the game on schedule.
2026_02_IND_KC.model_rationale: The matchup turns on Indianapolis containing Mahomes outside structure while Richardson uses mobility without exposing the Colts to negative plays against Kansas City’s pressure packages.
